description.message: AniWebScale enhances anime video in real time using Anime4K, WebGPU and an optional local Windows renderer.

extensionStatusSavedNotApplied.message: Extension status saved, but could not be applied.

frameGenerationLoad.message: Frame generation increases GPU memory use and processing load.

frameMotion2xEvenOff.message: Motion-aware 2x, even while enhancement is off.

modeADescription.message: Restores line detail, then applies Anime4K CNN upscaling. The balanced default for most anime.

modeAaDescription.message: Runs the Anime4K A restoration chain twice for stronger detail and up to 4x scaling. UL is a high-end GPU profile outside the 24 FPS baseline.

modeAcNetDescription.message: Small fixed 2x GLSL network that prioritizes speed and very low GPU load over maximum detail recovery.

modeArNetDescription.message: Deeper fixed 2x GLSL network with stronger detail recovery than ACNet at a higher, balanced GPU load.

modeArtCnnDescription.message: Fixed 2x GLSL network for reconstructing anime line art and natural detail at real-time speed.

modeBDescription.message: Uses softer restoration before Anime4K CNN upscaling to reduce ringing on blurry or compressed video.

modeBbDescription.message: Runs the softer Anime4K B chain twice for blurry sources and up to 4x scaling. UL is a high-end GPU profile outside the 24 FPS baseline.

modeCDescription.message: Denoises and upscales in one Anime4K CNN pass. Best suited to visibly noisy animation.

modeCaDescription.message: Denoises and upscales first, then restores and can upscale again. UL is a high-end GPU profile outside the 24 FPS baseline.

modeCnnDescription.message: Official Anime4K CNN at a fixed 2x scale. Produces a sharp result; Quality changes model size and GPU load.

modeOffDescription.message: Disables image enhancement. Frame generation can still be enabled separately.

Allow AniWebScale to capture this browser tab with the local Windows renderer for {origin}?
